Command.Comment: RAGIN phase3 CORE cert metadata no secrets

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo CERTS_ETC
for f in /etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt /etc/ragin/tls/server.crt /etc/ragin/tls/server.key; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    echo FILE=$f
    echo SIZE_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo stat_failed)
    openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName,extendedKeyUsage,keyId,authorityKeyIdentifier,keyUsage -in "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo PARSE_FAIL=$f
    echo FINGERPRINT_SUM=$(openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo fingerprint_failed)
    if [ "$f" = /etc/ragin/tls/server.key ] || [ "$f" = /etc/ragin/tls/edge.key ]; then
      echo KEY_FILE_NOT_PRINTED="$f"
    fi
  fi
done
echo DONE
